name: nexus-borrowings
title: Design mode drafts the runtime structure, the contracts, and the draft review
outcome: A design drafted in design mode carries its runtime structure. The design directory holds a runtime architecture diagram as a named diagram slot beside the three narrative levels, a contracts file when the design touches a public interface, and stage 6 runs a draft review subagent that validates against a blind rubric and re-explores alternatives before the engineer reads.
done_when: A design drafted in the updated design mode contains docs/architecture/designs/<name>/diagrams/runtime-architecture.mmd, build_index.py compiles it to record["diagrams"]["runtime"], and the viewer renders it as the lead tile of the design's architecture level with the level-1 overview untouched
A design whose design mode detects a public interface or durable state carries contracts.md compiled into its record index entity; a design that touches none carries none, and the skip is stated
Stage 6 runs the validate-and-re-explore reviewer before the engineer reads, its findings enter the review as classified challenges, and goal.min_work.draft_review_run records that it ran
Marketplace manifest versions for architect, implement, and artifact are bumped so installed users auto-update
abort_if: The named diagram slot breaks an existing designs record consumer — build_index.py designs projections or the viewer's design route
The runtime-architecture contract cannot express clustered boundaries and protocol-labeled boundary edges in mermaid within the single-page 8-to-30-node constraint

min_work.derived_from: 3 districts (cobuilder-packaging, architect, artifact), colliding ADRs 0005, 0018, 0025, 1 boundary rule (ADR-0020 build-free viewer)
